note: Portal order-details/fulfill screen is backed by a Hasura GraphQL endpoint, not the REST /api base. All calls below are query type 'get' (read-only) - no mutation was observed as a result of clicking 'Confirm & Send to fulfill', consistent with the click only opening a client-side preview/Connect-prompt modal.

calls.purpose: Fetch full order detail (order_by_pk) including order_items, variant, campaign, customization, order_item_artworks. Powers the order-details page render.
Fetch latest 1 order_item_activities row for the line item (used for the inline 'Latest log:' summary line on the order-details page).
Fetch FULL order_item_activities history (no limit) for the 'Item Activity logs' dialog - includes 'content' field not present in the summary query.

rest_endpoint_also_used.purpose: Powers the portal/orders LIST grid (paginated). Distinct from the GraphQL endpoint used for order-details.
